summary: E2E tested the full inscrição flow for Edital 014/2026 SEDUC/CE cargo + city replacement. Verified /inscricao.html -> /dados-inscricao.html -> /confirmacao -> /inscricao-realizada -> /pagamento-pix on desktop (1920x4000) and mobile (390x844). All data replacements are correct: 14 cargos (codes 1-14 Arte-Educação..Sociologia, each 'R$ 150,00'), 21 Ceará cities (Acaraú..Tianguá, no Macapá/Oiapoque/Laranjal), single lotação option, cotas laws 17.432/2021 and 17.433/2021 present on both dados and confirmação. Confirmação shows Vaga 'Professor de Matemática' + R$ 150,00 + Estado 'Ceará' + Município 'SOBRAL/CE'. inscricao-realizada shows cargo and R$ 150,00. Pagamento-pix shows expected 'Chave PIX não configurada' error (as noted in request, not a bug). Mobile: both selects visible, no horizontal overflow.

issues: When PIX key is not configured the page only shows the error message and omits the 'Valor R$ 150,00' summary. Expected per request (PIX key error is expected), but UX could display the valor + inscrição info even in error state so the candidate still sees the amount owed. Non-blocking.

MUNICIPIO_PROVA options contain exactly the 21 cities of CE and no stale AP cities (Macapá/Oiapoque/Laranjal). UF_PROVA is correctly fixed to 'CE'.
LOCAL_LOTACAO is a single required option matching the edital wording.
Cotas labels reference Lei Estadual nº 17.432/2021 (pessoas negras) and nº 17.433/2021 (PcD) on both dados-inscricao.html and confirmacao.html.
pagamento-pix.html fallback value is 150 (line ~868), consistent with the new uniform fee; it's only visible when PIX is configured, but the stored valor + inscricao-realizada already show R$ 150,00.
